steps.js: (async () => {const B='http://127.0.0.1:54321/rest/v1'; const H={'content-type':'application/json',Prefer:'return=representation'};const r=await fetch(B+'/task_types',{method:'POST',headers:H,body:JSON.stringify({"company_id": "9c307966-79f1-567c-ac4d-d5fd3c1a2f40", "name": "Entrega de material", "color": "#F97316", "description": "Entrega de material e ferramentas nos clientes", "is_active": true})});const root=document.getElementById('root'); const key=Object.keys(root).find(k=>k.startsWith('__reactContainer$'));const stack=[root[key]]; let n=0; let ok=false;while(stack.length&&n++<20000){const f=stack.pop(); if(!f) continue; const p=f.memoizedProps;if(p&&p.client&&typeof p.client.refetchQueries==='function'){p.client.refetchQueries({type:'active'}); ok=true; break;}if(f.sibling) stack.push(f.sibling); if(f.child) stack.push(f.child);}return r.status;})()
